_note: All Indian amounts in INR. Treaty-tier entries are qualitative ranges (no currency) — verify locally. Ranges reflect first/repeat offence unless stated. Verify with official authority before citing.

Vienna Convention on Road Traffic._note: Indicative ranges derived from signatory-state median enforcement. No currency — verify with local authority.

speeding.default: Moderate–severe fine + licence penalty points; suspension if >30 km/h over limit

drunk_driving.default: Heavy fine + immediate licence suspension (BAC > 0.05 g/dl in most signatories; 0.02 or zero for novice/commercial)

no_seatbelt.default: Fixed penalty (typically EUR 50–300 equivalent); driver liable for passengers under 16

no_helmet.bike: Fixed penalty; helmet must meet national safety standard and be fastened

mobile_phone.default: Fixed penalty + licence points in most signatory states; hands-free only permitted

wrong_way.default: Severe fine; may include licence suspension

no_license.default: Offence in all signatory states; domestic or international driving permit required

parking.default: Fine; vehicle may be towed at driver's expense

UN Model Road Safety Legislation._note: Based on UN Secretary-General Model Legislation 2019. Qualitative ranges — verify with local authority.

speeding.default: Fine + licence points; suspension for excess >30 km/h or repeat offending within 24 months

drunk_driving.default: BAC 0.05–0.08: fine + 90-day suspension (first); BAC >0.08 or repeat: criminal prosecution + imprisonment

no_seatbelt.default: Fixed fine; driver responsible for passengers under 16

no_helmet.bike: Fixed fine; helmet must meet UNECE Regulation 22 or equivalent

mobile_phone.default: Fixed fine + mandatory licence points; 30-day suspension for repeat within 24 months

EU Directive 2015/413._note: Eight offences enforceable cross-border within the EU via vehicle registration data exchange. Fine amounts per national law of the Member State where offence occurred.

speeding.default: Fine per host-country tariff + licence points; e.g. Germany >30 km/h EUR 280+, France EUR 135+

no_seatbelt.default: Fixed fine; e.g. Spain EUR 200, France EUR 135, Italy EUR 83–333

red_light.default: Fixed fine + licence points; e.g. Italy EUR 167–665, Germany EUR 90–235

drunk_driving.default: Fine + immediate suspension; e.g. France EUR 135 (BAC 0.05–0.08) + licence suspension for higher BAC

no_helmet.bike: Fixed fine; amount varies by Member State

wrong_way.default: Fine for use of forbidden lane (bus lane, emergency lane, etc.)

mobile_phone.default: Fixed fine; e.g. Netherlands EUR 380, Belgium EUR 174+, Germany EUR 100

no_license.default: Offence enforceable cross-border; vehicle may be impounded
